scenario: Cascade Robotics wants Tier-1 support triage automated across two channels: a Zendesk webhook for new tickets, and an #support-escalations Slack channel for urgent messages. A high-priority ticket should get a drafted reply and, if it's a billing complaint, an automatic refund up to $50 - above that, a human must approve. A duplicate/retried step must never issue a second refund.

workflows.name: Legacy Auto-Tagger (lower priority, same trigger - conflict demo)
